| `pilot-register.mjs` | `<checkout> --name <session name> --loop yes\|no [--pid <pid>] [--session <id>] [--sources-file <path>] [<source>...]` (pid and session default to `$CLAUDE_PID`, `$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`; `--sources-file` names the adapter's source list, one source per line, relative to the checkout or absolute, `~` expanding to `$HOME`, blank and `#` lines skipped; its sources join the positional ones) | `REGISTERED pid <pid>   since <since>`; `SESSION_APPENDED` when it appended the start line; then `pilot-sources --record`'s lines for the sources given; `STOP retired` when `sessions.md` has a handoff from this session; `STOP sources-file <path>` when the list file does not exist (nothing written) | 0; 4 `STOP`; 3 `CHECKPOINT_LOCKED` ([Checkpoint lock](#checkpoint-lock)) |
